Q:3/4=88

|: "G"B,2 G3 A | "D"B2 A2 Bc | "G"d2 cB AB | "C"c4 "D7"B2 |
w:G major, simple elegance, balanced phrases.
"D7"A2 ^F2 AB | "G"c2 Bc d2 | "D7"A2 dc BA | "G"G6 :|

%
V:LH

F,3 E, D,C, | B,,3 C, D,E, | F,3 E, D,C, | B,,2 D,2 G,2 :|
|: E,3 F, G,A, | B,,3 ^C, ^D,E, | A,3 G, F,E, | D,3 E, F,G, |
C,3 D, E,F, | G,3 A, B,C | D,3 E, ^F,G, | G,2 B,2 d2 :|

strengths: Clear binary form with proper repeat signs and balanced 8-bar phrases in each section
Functional Baroque-style harmonic progression with clear cadential targets
Bass line provides harmonic foundation with some stepwise motion
issues: Ends on dominant (D7→G in m.16 is tonic, but second section ends on G major—actually does end on tonic, contradicting score facts; more critically, the final cadence in m.16 and m.32 are both perfect authentic cadences on G, making the 'ends on tonic: NO' fact incorrect, though the score itself is internally consistent)
RH m.5-6: melodic leap from A to ^F to A to c creates awkward contour and weak voice-leading with exposed tritone; m.13-14 C major to G major progression lacks smooth bass connection

LH m.9-10 and m.25-26: B,, to ^C, leap is unidiomatic for Baroque bass, and the rising chromatic line clashes with the Baroque preference for diatonic stepwise motion; m.15-16 F,3 E, D,C, to B,,2 D,2 G,2 has rhythmic inconsistency (dotted quarter vs. quarter)
suggestions: Revise RH m.5-6 to smooth the melodic line: replace A2 ^F2 AB with A2 B2 c2 or similar stepwise motion, avoiding the exposed diminished fifth
Fix LH m.9-10 and m.25-26: replace B,,3 ^C, ^D,E, with B,,3 ^C, D,E, (natural D) or rewrite as E,3 D, C,B,, for proper voice-leading to the dominant
Standardize LH rhythmic values in final bars of each section: change m.8 and m.16 B,,2 D,2 G,2 to B,,3 D,2 G,2 or similar to match the prevailing dotted-quarter pattern
critic.summary: A competent but mechanically constructed minuet that captures basic Baroque harmonic syntax and binary form, yet suffers from unidiomatic voice-leading, awkward melodic leaps, and inconsistent bass rhythms that betray its algorithmic origins rather than compositional craft.
